text:
Aachen’s median asking rent stands at 11.57 €/m², up 2.6 % YoY and 24.1 % over the past five years, placing the city 18th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market remains balanced, with 26 days on market and 26 % of listings let within a week, while vacancy sits at 1.7 %.

Affordability is pressured: the asking premium over existing rents is 61 %, and a typical 60 m² unit costs about 694 € per month, generating a rent‑burden of 16.3 % for two residents. Population growth of 1.6 % over five years adds modest demand.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 12.28 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.9 €/m² and 12.59 €/m², implying a 6.1 % increase.
